speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe how this fatigue has been affecting your daily life, and have you noticed any accompanying symptoms like fever, weight loss, or pain?

speaker: Patient
text: It's really affecting my work because I struggle to concentrate even after sleeping all night. I haven't had a fever or lost any weight, though I do get occasional headaches. speaker: Doctor
text: Given your description of unrefreshing sleep, persistent fatigue, and headaches without fever or weight loss, this pattern is highly suggestive of a primary sleep disorder. DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Hypersomnia.
